summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge for Soony by analyzing the confidential supply-chain data drop and building a general agent product that finds hidden launch risks, acts on them (supplier emails, voice/push alerts), and surfaces evidence.
summary.outcome: Found that the Collector's Edition misses Sunday despite Soony's all-ok plan, built a poller, extraction, alert/voice/push agent and an evidence-anchoring module (PDF, table, OCR), and got PR #5 into main mergeable (164/164 tests). Briefing page, interview docs and anchoring were produced; the anchoring work was committed with OCR added to the Dockerfile, and PR #5 awaits Akshat's merge.

repo: Portal API has only three endpoints (files list, single file, archive.zip) and no notifications or webhooks; files can be replaced under the same name, so change detection must compare SHA-256 from the file list.
Confidential portal data lives in gitignored data/ (raw, drops, notes, state); .env holds the token and .env.example is committed with an empty token.

Entire 0.13.4 stores checkpoints as per-checkpoint refs (refs/entire/checkpoints/<xx>/<id>), not in the old entire/checkpoints/v1 branch; verify with git ls-remote origin 'refs/entire/checkpoints/*'. Entire only writes a checkpoint when repo files change.
Team workflow lives in CLAUDE.md and PROGRESS.md; tasks are claimed with a Now line in PROGRESS.md.

State env var is ASK_STATE_DIR (formerly ASK_SOONY_STATE_DIR). actions.json is a list owned by Akshat's inbox API; decision_status.json holds card status. Writing actions.json as a dict from other modules would wipe history.

Card builder dispatch/decisions/cards.py flattens evidence into plain strings, losing file/page references; the verifier linker (verifier.linker.build) already tracks source path and SHA-256 per record.

Data findings: art book receipt WZ-261116-473 booked 80,000 instead of 8,000; 5,600 statues failed AQL but are booked unrestricted; magnet shortage is a false alarm (PackRight fits them); sleeve rev B vs rev C conflict; Karton Nowak 24h offer of 8,000 art books closes the art book gap.
Portal PDFs: 214 of 217 are text PDFs; 60 images and 3 scanned PDFs need OCR (Korean, Chinese, Polish, English; tesseract language models available).

code.finding: Rewritten to the new card format; Approve button and spoken yes share one send function that only emails recipients matching portal supplier profiles.
New anchoring index: PDF text positions, table rows and tesseract OCR (TSV output, with split-word box deduping) used to locate card evidence values in source files.
New viewer wired into the evidence drawer: page image with yellow marker or table with highlighted row.
Edited by both Akshat (`direct` prop) and Jonas (`ringing`/`onRingingDone`) in the same line, causing a merge conflict resolved by keeping both.
Commit 3c4ce41 made /favicon.svg reachable without login; a stray uncommitted revert from another session was discarded.

workflow: Closing a PR that was hand-merged elsewhere and opening a fresh PR against the new integration branch was cleaner than updating the stale one; 'ready to merge' only means no textual conflicts, not semantic compatibility.
Two Claude sessions in one checkout share branch, files and commits and interfere (a favicon commit landed on the wrong branch); use separate worktrees.
Check teammates' branches before pushing and before touching shared files; announce touched files via the PR note.
Retarget the PR to main once the integration branch is merged and re-merge main to confirm no conflicts and passing tests.
Large exploratory data work is well delegated to a subagent (200 order confirmations and 59 scans cross-checked), then summarized into local notes.
A shell output filter that crashed swallowed a git push; always verify the push landed on the remote.

friction: Portal token was empty at first, blocking the data step until the user supplied it.
Entire appeared not to have recorded the session because it skips checkpoints when no files changed; another agent looked in the old checkpoint branch.
Graph plugin install failed without --force; the Entire status had stale Brain and Codex hook warnings.
First git push of PR #3 was lost due to a crashing output filter; a later push to main was rejected with a bare 'failed' and succeeded on retry.
Akshat rebuilt the UI and card API in parallel, which made PR #3 obsolete and removed voice, push and PWA from the new UI, requiring a rework.
Akshat's test used ASK_DATA_DIR but cards_file() ignored it, breaking a platform test on machines with real data.
A user-pasted screenshot did not arrive (only an empty file icon).
OCR initially returned only table matches and tesseract subprocess output needed a TSV fix, plus box deduping.
